subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Agile Supply Chains
description: A micro-lesson that makes Agile Supply Chains usable.

hook.text: Zara designs, produces, and delivers a new garment in 15 days. Competitors take 6 months. Speed is resilience.

buildup.text: Agile supply chains are designed to respond quickly to changes in demand, supply, or market conditions.

discovery.text: They use flexible production, small batches, local sourcing, and fast logistics to pivot rapidly.

twist.text: Agility costs more per unit than lean efficiency. It's an investment in responsiveness, not cost reduction.

climax.text: During COVID, agile companies pivoted product lines in weeks. Rigid ones waited months for recovery.

punchline.text: Agility absorbs shocks that efficiency amplifies.

quiz.question: How does agility differ from lean efficiency?
options: Agility prioritizes responsiveness over lowest cost
